mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_chat_summary_states ( user_id, summary_date, source_version, source_updated_at, status, retry_count, changed_sources, daily_goal_snapshot_payload, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{summaryDate}, 1, NOW(), 'STALE', 0, #{changedSources}, #{dailyGoalSnapshotPayload}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, summary_date) DO UPDATE SET source_version = daily_chat_summary_states.source_version + 1, source_updated_at = NOW(), status = CASE WHEN daily_chat_summary_states.status = 'CLAIMED' THEN 'CLAIMED' ELSE 'STALE' END, retry_count = CASE WHEN daily_chat_summary_states.status = 'CLAIMED' THEN daily_chat_summary_states.retry_count ELSE 0 END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN daily_chat_summary_states.status = 'CLAIMED' THEN daily_chat_summary_states.next_retry_at ELSE NULL END, failure_code = NULL, changed_sources = ( SELECT string_agg(source, ',' ORDER BY source) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT source FROM unnest(string_to_array( concat_ws( ',', NULLIF(daily_chat_summary_states.changed_sources, ''), NULLIF(EXCLUDED.changed_sources, '') ), ',' )) source WHERE source <> '' ) merged_sources ), daily_goal_snapshot_payload = COALESCE( EXCLUDED.daily_goal_snapshot_payload, daily_chat_summary_states.daily_goal_snapshot_payload ), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT user_id, summary_date FROM daily_chat_summary_states WHERE summary_date >= #{oldestRegenerableDate} AND summary_date < #{currentDate} AND source_updated_at <= #{debounceExpiredBefore} AND ( status = 'STALE' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'CLAIMED' AND claimed_at <= #{claimExpiredBefore}) ) ORDER BY summary_date ASC, source_updated_at ASC, user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE daily_chat_summary_states target SET status = 'CLAIMED', claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW() FROM candidates WHERE target.user_id = candidates.user_id AND target.summary_date = candidates.summary_date RETURNING target.user_id, target.summary_date, target.source_version, target.source_updated_at, target.status, target.claim_token, target.claimed_at, target.retry_count, target.next_retry_at, target.failure_code, target.changed_sources, target.daily_goal_snapshot_payload, target.created_at, target.updated_at

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT user_id, summary_date FROM daily_chat_summary_states WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND summary_date >= #{oldestRegenerableDate} AND summary_date < #{currentDate} AND source_updated_at <= #{debounceExpiredBefore} AND ( status = 'STALE' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'CLAIMED' AND claimed_at <= #{claimExpiredBefore}) ) ORDER BY summary_date DESC, source_updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE daily_chat_summary_states target SET status = 'CLAIMED', claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW() FROM candidates WHERE target.user_id = candidates.user_id AND target.summary_date = candidates.summary_date RETURNING target.user_id, target.summary_date, target.source_version, target.source_updated_at, target.status, target.claim_token, target.claimed_at, target.retry_count, target.next_retry_at, target.failure_code, target.changed_sources, target.daily_goal_snapshot_payload, target.created_at, target.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_chat_summary_states SET status = 'FRESH', claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL, changed_sources = '', daily_goal_snapshot_payload = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND summary_date = #{summaryDate} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND source_version = #{sourceVersion}
